rows.note: The test builds one finding with make_finding, calls build_report and render_json, then checks the schema plus allowlists, content flags, counts, coverage, and fingerprint length. validate_report_json checks one instance. A synthetic render is not that make_finding call.
The test renders include_content and asserts content_warning, included_content, and the finding allowlist. validate_report_json does not perform those extra asserts.

load_report_schema opens the schema file and checks that repro, content flags, coverage, span, and remediation exist. validate_report_json does not open a path. Recording those names in facts is not that loader call.
The test opens the schema file and compares it with the Report model. validate_report_json checks one instance.
load_report_schema raises FileNotFoundError when the schema path is missing. validate_report_json does not open a path.
get_report_schema_path follows the prefix share directory when the repo schema is hidden. No vector resolves a schema path.
get_report_schema_path and get_manifest_schema_path return the development-path fallback. No vector resolves a schema path.
